sn43.2:1.1: ca vo bhikkhave desissāmi asaṅkhatagāmiñca maggaṃ || taṃ suṇātha || || Katamañca bhikkhave asaṅkhataṃ || || Yo bhikkhave rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo || idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave asaṅkhataṃ || || Katamo ca bhikkhave asaṅkhatagāmi maggo || || Samatho vipassanā ca || ayam vuccati bhikkhave asaṅkhatagāmi maggo || la || ||
